enum Failure: Error { case failed }
func inOrder<T, E: Error>(_ items: [T], step: (T) async throws(E) -> Void, reason: String)
  async throws(E)
{
  for item in items { try await step(item) }
}
func inOrderSteps<E: Error>(_ steps: [() async throws(E) -> Void], reason: String) async throws(E) {
  for step in steps { try await step() }
}
